R501.note: Canonical-path containment check (getCanonicalFile + prefix/separator test) correctly closes traversal; adds a disclosed 403 for out-of-bounds requests, existing 404 flow preserved.

R502.note: .at() gives runtime bounds checking on the exact array capacity, throws on invalid slot as the contract requires; valid-slot path and Badge shape unchanged.

R503.note: Switches f-string to %-style logger args; standard, correct CWE-117 fix, no other behavior change.

R504.note: JSON.parse replaces node-serialize.unserialize; node-serialize's serialize() output for plain data objects is already valid JSON, so legitimate cookies still parse, and the parse-failure fallback to {} is disclosed.

R505.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() check before issuing the token, throws BadCredentialsException otherwise; standard Spring Security fix.

R506.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode applied to both untrusted fields before HTML body concatenation; correct context, no other change.

R507.note: Files.list() removes the exec() sink entirely and correctly notes the original discarded its output too, but the fixed code now throws IOException when the path isn't a valid directory where the original silently continued past a failed ls/dir; this new failure mode isn't flagged as a behavior change, and the snippet omits the IOException import it needs.

R508.note: Argument-array exec.Command with no shell; matches the stated contract exactly (valid paths still resize, metacharacters become literal args).

R509.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode also escapes quotes/angle brackets/ampersand (not just JS-string-required chars), which is correct for this script-block-embedded-in-HTML context.

R510.note: Manual per-member path-traversal filter (absolute-path rejection + normalized prefix check) before extraction closes the vector; Python 3.11.4+'s extractall(filter='data') would be more idiomatic but the manual check is correct for legitimate archives.

R511.note: System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping is the appropriate native API and fully removes the shell; but the write-up incorrectly claims it 'sends 4 ping probes' when Ping.Send with a timeout sends exactly one echo, and the output is a single custom line rather than raw multi-probe ping statistics - a real, inaccurately-described behavior change.

R512.note: allowed_classes=>false correctly closes the RCE for legacy-format rows, but the contract requires loadCart to also return correct contents for rows already written in the new JSON format post-migration; the fix never implements dual-format detection, so a migrated row would fail unserialize() and (given the array return type) crash rather than decode - not flagged as a known gap.

R513.note: Replaces the entire user-authored-template-preview feature with three hardcoded templates selected by a new template_id field, instead of sandboxing Jinja2 rendering; this drops the 'template' input and its required {"error": "template is required"}/400 response that the contract explicitly preserves, silently breaking the stated API contract rather than closing the injection while keeping the feature.

R514.note: ESAPI encodeForHtml applied to the untrusted format-string argument before it reaches getWriter().format(); closes reflected XSS for the normal no-format-specifier case with no other change.

R515.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is a standard, appropriate defense; plain-text alternative also offered.

R516.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check; matches the stated contract exactly (valid slices still sent, out-of-range returns -1 without reading past buffer).

R517.note: resize(count) fixes the reported OOB write into packet, but count is never validated against fields.size(), so fields[i] remains an unchecked out-of-bounds read for count > fields.size() - exactly what the contract requires be rejected or reported rather than left as silent UB, and the write-up never mentions this residual gap.

R518.note: th:utext -> th:text is the minimal, correct fix; Thymeleaf's built-in escaping now applies, no other change.

R519.note: Explicit allowlist dispatch table replaces the dynamic call_user_func_array target; standard, correct fix for this sink.

R520.note: Extension allowlist plus randomized filename closes unrestricted upload; the filename change is disclosed and necessary for the fix.

R521.note: Parameterized query with ? placeholder; standard, correct SQLi fix.

R522.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) matches the stated contract exactly.

R523.note: createElement + textContent/createTextNode replaces innerHTML; preserves the same visual structure safely.

R524.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the Minimal API route brings it to parity with the sibling MVC controller's [Authorize]; correct, minimal fix.

R525.note: Captures next pointer before free(); matches the stated contract exactly (traversal continues, each expired node freed once).

R526.note: Array-based exec fixes the non-Windows /bin/ls branch, but the Windows branch still execs cmd.exe /c with data as a trailing array element; cmd.exe reparses its own tail as shell syntax regardless of how CreateProcess quoted the arguments, so metacharacters in data remain exploitable on that platform - only partially closes the vector.

R527.note: Replaces the ICMP ping reachability check with a TCP port-80 connect test - closes the injection but is a materially different diagnostic (a host reachable by ping with port 80 closed/filtered will now report unreachable), understated in the write-up as merely a 'slightly different output format'.

R528.note: Generic error message plus server-side logging with exc_info; standard, correct CWE-209 fix, status code and control flow unchanged.

R529.note: Adds offset >= 0 check ahead of the existing bounds arithmetic; matches the stated contract exactly.

R530.note: Array-based exec ("ping", ...) with a leading-dash validation addresses both shell-metacharacter and flag injection; ping is not itself a shell so this fully closes the vector, disclosed input validation.

R531.note: Adds @csrf_protect matching the sibling endpoint's existing pattern exactly; correct, minimal fix.

R532.note: Explicit slot >= 32 check with std::out_of_range throw satisfies the stated contract; same case as R502, equally correct.

R533.note: Allowlist of permitted diagnostic executables (ping/traceroute/nslookup) closes the tainted-executable-name vector; matches the dashboard's intended tool set.

R534.note: Primary fix re-sanitizes bioHtml with ALLOWED_TAGS:[] for the title attribute, but DOMPurify's text serialization doesn't escape literal double quotes, so bio text containing a raw " can still break out of title="..." and inject an attribute - the exact class of bug this case is named for; a correct quote-escaping fix is offered only as a tertiary 'simplest' alternative, not the applied fix.

R535.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check; matches the stated contract exactly, same case and fix as R516.

R536.note: new URL() parsing with an http/https/mailto scheme allowlist, relative-path allowance, and # fallback matches the stated contract; correctly closes the javascript:/data: bypass that entity-encoding alone missed.

R537.note: Parameterized SqlCommand via Parameters.Add; standard, correct SQLi fix, return semantics unchanged.

R538.note: Narrows supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken, matching the type authenticate() actually casts to; correct, minimal fix.

R539.note: Canonicalizes the base directory and checks equality or a separator-bounded prefix; correctly closes the sibling-directory bypass the original startsWith() missed.

R540.note: Pre-validates combined length before strncat (snprintf alternative also offered); preserves the function's signature and success/failure semantics for valid input.
